correctness.rationale: Counting ones among the 2k-1 other vertices yields exact three-case global map: if r=a+b<k then F(X,Y)=(0,1), if r=k then F(X,Y)=(complement X,Y), if r>k then F(X,Y)=(1,0). The four special states form one 4-cycle; only configurations a=b=k/2 (even k) form primitive 2-cycles; no other period or fixed point. Counts T0=4+B_k, T1=4^k-C(2k,k)-2, T2=C(2k,k)-2-B_k follow by separating r=k and four-cycle states; bound T<=2 sharp k>=3. Independent direct per-vertex graph updates verified all 5460 states for k<=6. Product Bernoulli measure gives B_k[p(1-p)]^k; Stirling yields fixed-s critical window (2/pi k)e^(-4s^2). Quantifiers and k=1,2 handled analytically.
